declarations.name: AuiFormBuilder

inputs.name: schema
inputs.description: Initial schema (root type object). Default: an empty form.

inputs.name: fieldTypes
inputs.description: Field types offered in the palette, in order. Default: all 18.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon overrides: undo, redo, remove, handle.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of the builder's messages and controls.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The document changed (edit, reorder, import, undo, redo): { schema, uiSchema }, always valid for Schema Form.

methods.name: addField
methods.signature: addField(type: FormBuilderFieldType, index?: number | undefined): string | undefined
methods.description: Add a field after the selection or at index; returns its name.

methods.name: removeField
methods.description: Remove a field and the conditions that use it.

methods.name: selectField
methods.description: Select a field, or null for the form settings.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Step through the history (also Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y, Ctrl+Shift+Z outside text fields).

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Step through the history (also Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y, Ctrl+Shift+Z outside text fields).

accessibility.pattern: Toolbar plus Tabs (Design, Preview, JSON); the canvas is a Sortable List (keyboard grab, move, drop with announcements); the palette and properties are labelled regions of native buttons and AbsoluteUI form controls.

limitations: The builder edits top-level fields; nested groups and lists from imported JSON are kept and can be reordered, renamed, and removed, but their inner fields are edited in the JSON view.
The visibility editor writes one condition per field (equals, does not equal, is filled, is empty); combined conditions are kept and edited in the JSON view.
